stronger_arguments.description: Northern-Hemisphere Westerlies control (carry-forward from c3, still unintegrated). The Ferrel-cell prediction is identical at 40-50°N — midlatitude westerlies, fragmented by continental friction. Standard physics predicts the NH/SH asymmetry (continuous Southern Ocean vs. continent-broken NH); a disc-edge-pressure model that is azimuthally symmetric about the disc center predicts a symmetric NH/SH wind belt at the corresponding latitude. The observed NH/SH fragmentation difference is exactly what Ferrel + landmass-distribution physics predicts and exactly the opposite of what symmetric-disc-pressure predicts.

Joint-uniformity test. The longitude-mismatch argument can be tightened into a single dilemma: if rim pressure is azimuthally symmetric, the SAA should be 360° (it isn't); if rim pressure is azimuthally asymmetric, the wind belt should be longitudinally non-uniform (it isn't). Both branches refute the shared-cause claim; the WIN cannot escape via WIN-030 or WIN-032 invocations. This frames the disc-shape escape attempt as a no-win for the defender.

kernel_of_truth.description: The Roaring 40s and SAA southern edge do overlap in latitude — both lie in the ~40-50°S band (data/wins.json:024 detail_evidence acknowledges this with the IGRF/WMM 32,000 nT contour at sea level reference). The latitude coincidence is empirically real and not a fabrication. A careful reader of NOAA wind climatology and CHAOS-7 geomagnetic data will confirm the overlap; the dome author has not invented it.
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Latitude coincidence is the weakest form of causal evidence because latitude is a 1-dimensional band sampled by every meridian. The decisive test is longitude (data/wins.json:024 detail_evidence: 'The Roaring 40s encircle the entire Southern Hemisphere at all longitudes...The SAA, by contrast, is confined to approximately 90°W-40°E (roughly one-third of the circumference)'). A shared-cause hypothesis at the disc edge predicts the longitude distributions match; observation shows one is global and the other is one-third of the circumference. The kernel-of-truth (latitude match) is statistically expected from any two phenomena that happen to peak in the same hemisphere; it provides essentially zero discriminatory power for the dome model versus standard physics.

advocate_mode.best_defense: A sophisticated dome defender steps inside our review's framework and argues: 'You correctly note that azimuthal symmetry of the disc predicts a 360° SAA. But the dome model itself has never claimed azimuthal symmetry — WIN-030 establishes an elliptical disc, and WIN-032 establishes a New Jerusalem polar axis as the geometric privileged direction. An elliptical disc with a long axis aligned with the South Atlantic naturally produces stronger rim pressure on that side, concentrating the SAA into ~130° of longitude. The wind belt, being a much weaker rim-pressure effect smeared by atmospheric circulation, propagates to all longitudes. So your longitude-mismatch refutation strawmans a symmetric disc the model never claimed.'
advocate_mode.preemptive_recommendation: Add one sentence per hole #1 above.
